pairs.why: The two toasters are almost the same, but B has softer, less mirror-like highlights on the metal, closer to the moderate shine on the real camera and vending machine than A's slightly glossier, statue-like finish.
This is the same near-identical pair with the order swapped: A has the softer metal shine, while B's brighter highlights push it toward the over-glossy look the lessons marked down.

A's full flame with a warm glow on the stove and its light condensation drops give the lively, staged warmth of the real cards (for example the cooler with ice), while B's small flame makes it read flatter.
This is the same pair with the order swapped: B has the full, glowing flame and the condensation drops that match the vivid, story-driven finish of the real cards better than A's small flame.
